Macrons

Consonantal i

Kitchen, meals & drinks

grill noun and verb

also gridiron, barbecue, broil

classical

Traupman 71, 276

crāticula, crāticulae f.

noun, first declension

grill, gridiron

Examples

  • rāra tibi curvā crāticula sūdet ofellā

    let the gridiron sizzle with a few chopsMart. 14.221.1

Other words

  • super crāticulam assāre — to grill, barbecue

    also used · modern · Traupman 71, 276

See also chop, roast.

SourcesLewis & Short: craticula · Lewis & Short: assus

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): pp. 71, 276.
